title: Network status
description: status.json. Network-wide totals over every service day collected so far, for the status strip. Trip origins are left out of every count, because they measure a departure and not an arrival.

first_day.description: The earliest service day in the data, as YYYY-MM-DD.

last_day.description: The latest service day in the data, as YYYY-MM-DD. This is the freshness date to show, because the file carries no run time.

days.description: How many service days have data. Days with no data are not counted, so this can be less than the span from first_day to last_day.

scheduled_stops.description: Scheduled stops over all days, measured or not.

measured_arrivals.description: Scheduled stops where a vehicle was seen and the delay could be measured.

estimated_arrivals.description: Of measured_arrivals, the stops placed between two position reports of the same bus because the feed never reported them. The rest were seen at the stop or timed from an approach report.

coverage_pct.description: measured_arrivals as a percent of scheduled_stops, to one decimal place. It includes estimated_arrivals.

lines.description: Distinct lines in the scheduled stops. This can be larger than the number of lines in index.json, which lists only lines with at least one measured arrival.

trips.description: Distinct scheduled trip ids over all days.
